ev.q: Fighters can traverse the levels free-roaming in large spaces and can fight on ground, in the air and underwater
players are able to customize their character's race, gender, facial hair, body features, clothing
noting the repetitiveness of in-game missions
the general game design from balancing issues to repetitiveness is heavily criticized
while also criticizing its loose controls, repetitiveness and unbalanced gameplay
giving praise for the game's fighting mechanics and aesthetics
